summary: Modoc County lookout on the Modoc National Forest: 1934 ECW original, current building per NHLR 1934/1974, 1952 generator fire, CAL FIRE-administered and on its 2022 list.

facts.design: Fredonyer-style tower (Plan 889-1A per NHLR) with the standard 7 3 2-6A cab
facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection, Lassen-Modoc Unit (Cal Fire LMU)

access.note: No source read describes public access today; CAL FIRE says it does not rent its lookouts (2008 fact sheet)

events.note: Original ECW lookout constructed for the Modoc National Forest in 1934; a 1935 newspaper item reported a new lookout house built the previous summer
Forest fire broke out in the neighborhood of Fitzhugh Creek near the Manzanita Lookout Station
Forest budget memo lists a lookout observation unit with living quarters underneath, a two-car garage, and headquarters for a logging-area patrolman
Lookout made 28 first discoveries during 1942 through 1946

August 1952 fire in the lookout building; gasoline fumes from a radio battery generator ignited by a refrigerator flame; damage negligible. Generators were then removed from living quarters in lookouts
CDF assumed operation of the site in the early 1970s
Register Built field reads 1934/1974; the existing building replaced the 1934 original. No further detail in sources read
CAL FIRE June 2008 fact sheet lists Manzanita Peak Lookout (Modoc County) among lookouts that may be staffed during the 2008 fire season
Still listed as Manzanita Peak Lookout (Modoc County) in CAL FIRE's March 2022 lookout fact sheet

corrections.current: 1934 built ('Built' field on NHLR detail page)
corrections.proposed: 1934 built as the original ECW lookout; the existing building replaced it (NHLR Built field reads 1934/1974)
corrections.why: The Register's Built field reads 1934/1974, and its description says the existing building replaced the 1934 original. The brief record gives only 1934.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register uses Manzanita Mountain (Manzanita Ridge) Lookout; CAL FIRE's 2008 and 2022 fact sheets use Manzanita Peak Lookout. Both refer to the Modoc County site.

notes_for_editor: Correction proposed for the 1934 built event: the Register's Built field reads 1934/1974. The 1974 date is not explained in the sources read; the 1952 fire and 1935 item indicate the 1934 building existed then, so the replacement date is not clear. The 2008 CAL FIRE table lists it as Manzanita Peak Lookout, Modoc County. The 2008 staffed status is a 'may be staffed' list, not a record of actual staffing. The Forest Lookouts page for Manzanita is a 1935-1956 record set; nothing after 1956 was in the cached text. Staffing and access today are unknown.
